    "LC": "The delivered attack places natural-language instructions in the latest chat message, and the detector extracts their URL directly into the outbound tool path (damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/payloads/agentpwn-mirror.js:59-75; damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/index.js:1194-1271). Although presented as RAG poisoning, this delivery does not require retrieval-source ingestion or independently enforced security mediation.",

The persistent existence of the original knowledge-base documents is not attacker-controlled memory carryover.",
    "AP": "Influence passes from RAGBot's message-processing component into its in-process submit_to_index executor under the same principal (damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/index.js:1194-1271; damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/index.js:293-319). The collector receives data, but no subsequent agent or principal is shown adopting the injected intent.",
    "RH": "The reachable path sets attackSucceeded and updates success tracking before establishing the HTTP outcome, exposing an in-process evaluation proxy (damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/index.js:1194-1271). No human-verified reward-hacking episode is reported; the documented expected A/B output concerns exfiltration and capability enforcement, not verified evaluator manipulation (damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/README.md:216-259).",
    "ES": "Although the tool name and HTTP method are fixed, the injected URL controls the destination without an independent host allowlist or least-privilege destination binding (damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/payloads/agentpwn-mirror.js:59-75; damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/index.js:293-319). Restricting the scheme to HTTP(S) and matching a fixed path does not independently constrain the destination authority.",
    "CVSS": "Default listeners and documented Docker publications are loopback-only, making AV:L appropriate; an attacker with access to that unauthenticated interface can submit the message without another human, giving PR:N/UI:N, while wildcard CORS additionally permits a browser-mediated variant (damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/README.md:26; damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/index.js:1561-1564). The deterministic detector needs no defense bypass, secret, race, or exceptional configuration, supporting AC:L/AT:N (damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/payloads/agentpwn-mirror.js:59-75). Disclosure of every configured knowledge-base document, including the planted admin password and SSN, supports VC:H, but no integrity, availability, or additional subsequent-system impact is established; the collection endpoint already belongs to the attacker (damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/core/agents.js:301-332; damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/index.js:1194-1271)."
